name: agency_abandoned_reason_total
description: Abandoned attempts by cause

name: agency_abandoned_total
description: Agency dialer attempts a customer answered that reached no agent

name: agency_abandonment_rate_24h
description: Rolling 24h abandonment rate, percent (numerator/denominator also exported)

name: agency_abandonment_window_abandoned_24h
description: Abandoned attempts in the rolling 24h window (the rate numerator)

name: agency_abandonment_window_answered_24h
description: Answered attempts in the rolling 24h window (the rate denominator)

name: agency_answer_latency_seconds
description: Seconds from dial to the carrier answer, for attempts that answered

name: agency_answered_total
description: Agency dialer attempts the carrier reported answered

name: agency_attempt_hold_seconds
description: Seconds an agent was held for one attempt, from dial to attempt settle, by outcome (wrap-up is separate)

name: agency_away_ring_ended_total
description: Absences on away_ring (an away agent's phone rung for inbound callers, Mode B) that ended, by why: ring_missed, revoked, opted_out, flag_off, max_age, taken_over (another device took the station, or the session was left from one) or returned (the agent came back to the app)

name: agency_bind_latency_seconds
description: Seconds from the carrier answer to the agent station socket attaching (budget: 1s)

name: agency_bind_total
description: Late-bind attempts by result: bound, or the AgencyAbandonReason that stopped it

name: agency_campaign_slots_allocated
description: Live attempts of a running campaign plus the new dials the pacing round granted it (contended accounts only)

name: agency_campaign_slots_in_use
description: Live attempts of a running campaign as the pacing round read them (contended accounts only)

name: agency_inbound_answer_seconds
description: Seconds the inbound answer webhook took to answer the carrier, by result: stream, spoken (a message the carrier speaks), hangup, fallback, refused or timed_out

name: agency_inbound_answered_wait_seconds
description: Seconds a connected inbound caller waited in the queue (from first queueing), by the channel of the offer that connected them: station (the station socket) or push (a ring to an away phone)

name: agency_inbound_applications
description: Credentials with inbound enabled, by the last scheduled health check of their carrier Application: ok, url_mismatch, app_missing, unreachable or failed (the check could not run)

name: agency_inbound_calls_total
description: Inbound calls ended, by outcome: answered, abandoned_in_queue, overflow, overflow_no_capacity, closed, voicemail, rejected or failed

name: agency_inbound_connect_available
description: 1 when this deployment puts inbound callers through to agents (MEDIA_WORKERS=0), 0 when it cannot (media workers on: every open route answers with the call-back message, IB8); set at boot

name: agency_inbound_offers_total
description: Offers of an inbound caller to an agent, by how each ended: connected, caller_left (hung up while offered), station_lost, lease_lost, refused (the call or the session was no longer free, or the station could no longer take inbound calls), declined (the agent hung up the offer, or declined the ring), bind_refused (the bridge would not bind the agent's socket), unanswered (a ring expired, lapsed after the answer, or its push failed), answered_elsewhere (a station agent took the caller mid-ring) or cancelled (a ring ended with its away break); by the station's client (web: the console, mobile: a phone) and by channel (station: the station socket, push: a ring to an away phone)

name: agency_inbound_overflows_total
description: Inbound callers overflowed from the queue (the route's overflow action), by why: max_wait (waited the route's maximum), over_cap (over max_waiting with nobody free) or no_agents (nobody in the pool could take them)

name: agency_inbound_queue_waiting
description: Inbound callers waiting for an agent on a route right now (on offer excluded), set as the queue changes

name: agency_inbound_ring_answer_seconds
description: Seconds from the start of a ring to the agent answering it on the phone (Mode B; the ring window is 20 s)

name: agency_inbound_ring_bind_seconds
description: Seconds from the agent answering a ring on the phone to the call binding to the app's station (Mode B; the accept grace is 15 s): the cold start's headroom

name: agency_inbound_rings_total
description: Rings of an away agent's phone for an inbound caller (Mode B), by how each ended: answered, declined, expired, accept_lapsed, busy_on_phone, push_failed, caller_left, answered_elsewhere or cancelled

name: agency_inbound_wait_seconds
description: Seconds an inbound caller waited in the queue (from first queueing), by how the wait ended: connected, abandoned, overflow or failed

name: agency_insights_rollup_buckets_total
description: Insights rollup buckets recomputed

name: agency_insights_rollup_dirty_buckets
description: Insights rollup buckets marked dirty and not yet recomputed, after the last pass

name: agency_insights_rollup_failures_total
description: Insights rollup batches that failed and were rolled back (their marks stay dirty)

name: agency_insights_rollup_oldest_dirty_seconds
description: Age of the oldest insights rollup dirty mark after the last pass, seconds (0 when none)

name: agency_insights_rollup_recompute_seconds
description: Seconds one insights rollup batch took: claim, recompute and commit

name: agency_live_attempts_current
description: Agency dialer attempts that have not reached `ended`, by attempt state

name: agency_live_manual_calls_current
description: Agency soft-phone calls that have not reached `ended`, by call state

name: agency_our_fault_retirement_total
description: Contacts permanently retired by exhausting the our-fault redial ledger

name: agency_pacing_history_dropped_total
description: Campaign minutes of pacing history dropped unwritten (oldest first, beyond the pending cap)

name: agency_pacing_history_write_failures_total
description: Pacing history writes that failed (batch: kept for the next flush; direct: lost)

name: agency_pacing_missed_wakeups_total
description: Pacing safety ticks that found work no invalidation event announced

name: agency_pacing_share_withheld_total
description: Dials the per-account share rule held back from a campaign while its account had headroom

name: agency_pacing_ticks_total
description: Scheduled pacing ticks, full or skipped, by the cause of a full tick

name: agency_predial_gate_total
description: Pre-dial gate decisions, by gate and what the tick did about it

name: agency_reports_assemble_seconds
description: Seconds the assembler took to build and upload one report dataset, claim to recorded

name: agency_reports_callbacks_total
description: Render callbacks received, by result: applied, stale, bad_signature or invalid

name: agency_reports_emails_total
description: Report-ready emails, by result: sent, skipped or failed

name: agency_reports_oldest_pending_seconds
description: Age of the oldest pending report run at the last tick, seconds (0 when none)

name: agency_reports_pending_runs
description: Report runs queued, assembling or rendering, set by the reports tick

name: agency_reports_render_seconds
description: Seconds from sending a report run to the renderer to applying its callback

name: agency_reports_runs_total
description: Report runs that reached a terminal status (ready or failed), by kind

name: agency_reports_subscription_runs_total
description: Subscription periods turned into runs, by result: created, duplicate (the period already had one), or flag_off (skipped: agency_reports_enabled off for the account)

name: agency_tick_idle_total
description: Ticks that dialed nothing, by benign reason (no agents, no slots, no contacts)

name: agency_wrapup_seconds
description: Wrap-up duration in seconds, by resolution
